title: Console frontend hygiene: devDependencies, dynamic imports, duplicate modules, helper tests
description: From kbs-29c415: move express, cors, chokidar, express-rate-limit and js-yaml (dev-server only) to devDependencies; dynamic-import mermaid and the MQTT/SigV4 path so the local console bundle does not load them; delete the pre-extraction copies of @kanbus/ui modules (IssueCard.tsx, useBoardTransitions.ts, diverged issue-colors.ts) in favour of the package; add vitest for pure helpers and run it in CI.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Done: PR #539 merged (7b1ab86), all 25 checks green. Dev-server packages moved to devDependencies, unused mermaid removed (MQTT and SigV4 were already lazy chunks), five dead pre-extraction modules deleted, issue-colors.ts trimmed to the metrics-only helpers with colours unchanged, 79 vitest tests run in CI. Color-coding steps in both runtimes now read @kanbus/ui issue-colors.ts.
